arms.name: random_calibrated
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional training step and greater total cost

calibration.method: one scalar temperature per arm fitted by LBFGS on the same separately generated calibration stream
calibration.deployment: ordinary dense inference with logits divided by the fitted temperature
calibration.equal_opportunity: identical calibration data, fitting rule, and calibration compute budget for every arm
calibration.accuracy: unchanged by scalar temperature and retained as a secondary endpoint

validation.uncalibrated_reproduction_requirement: rerun low-87.5 and dense-100 final uncalibrated losses must match their existing references within 2e-6; otherwise the calibrated comparison is invalid

cost_accounting.training: same realized-row CPU-calibrated dense-forward sparse-backward formula as the 87.5% experiment; dense pays full forward/backward cost
cost_accounting.calibration_forward: forward-only executed model FLOPs for eight calibration batches; the MPS standard-backward undercount does not apply to these forward-only measurements
cost_accounting.calibration_aux: ten estimated operations per calibration logit per LBFGS closure evaluation, included in total cost
cost_accounting.final_evaluation: reported separately and excluded from training-plus-calibration cost for every arm

primary_endpoint: temperature-calibrated ordinary dense held-out loss at final training-plus-calibration cost

decision_rules.validity_first: if low or dense uncalibrated reproduction fails, stop without interpreting calibrated outcomes
decision_rules.allocation_failure: low_max_abs calibrated loss is not below random calibrated loss despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: low_max_abs beats random but not dense-fewer; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs calibrated loss is below both random and dense while its total training-plus-calibration cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: fitting temperature on the final held-out seed
excluding calibration forward or optimization cost
changing steps, calibration data, fitting rule, or final evaluation after launch
launching body 7 without a development-level calibrated win
